<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Like <a href="#a2d9861feadd3a09792967a012559e7b2">m_Specific()</a>, but works if the specific value to match is determined as part of the same <a href="#a25d956d9e0beadd47ce4bc255dfa811d">match()</a> expression.</p>


<p>For example: m_Add(m_Value(X), m_Specific(X)) is incorrect, because <a href="#a2d9861feadd3a09792967a012559e7b2">m_Specific()</a> will bind X before the pattern match starts. m_Add(m_Value(X), m_Deferred(X)) is correct, and will check against whichever value m_Value(X) populated.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Match an 'ordered' floating point maximum function.</p>


<p>Floating point has one special value 'NaN'. Therefore, there is no total order. However, if we can ignore the 'NaN' value (for example, because of a 'no-nans-float-math' flag) a combination of a fcmp and select has 'maximum' semantics. In the presence of 'NaN' we have to preserve the original select(fcmp(ogt/ge, L, R), L, R) semantics matched by this predicate.</p>



<pre><code>                    max(L, R)  iff L and R are not NaN
</code></pre>


<p>m_OrdFMax(L, R) = R iff L or R are NaN</p>


<p>Definition at line 2386 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/patternmatch-h">PatternMatch.h</a>.</p>


<p>References <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/x86/x86partialreduction-cpp/#a9e1483f7215664a2315c53c3558d9a8d">LHS</a> and <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/x86/x86partialreduction-cpp/#a87b8bfbbe9d8f7146d7f20a5fb42efd0">RHS</a>.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Match an 'unordered' floating point maximum function.</p>


<p>Floating point has one special value 'NaN'. Therefore, there is no total order. However, if we can ignore the 'NaN' value (for example, because of a 'no-nans-float-math' flag) a combination of a fcmp and select has 'maximum' semantics. In the presence of 'NaN' we have to preserve the original select(fcmp(ugt/ge, L, R), L, R) semantics matched by this predicate.</p>



<pre><code>                    max(L, R)  iff L and R are not NaN
</code></pre>


<p>m_UnordFMax(L, R) = L iff L or R are NaN</p>


<p>Definition at line 2417 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/patternmatch-h">PatternMatch.h</a>.</p>


<p>References <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/x86/x86partialreduction-cpp/#a9e1483f7215664a2315c53c3558d9a8d">LHS</a> and <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/x86/x86partialreduction-cpp/#a87b8bfbbe9d8f7146d7f20a5fb42efd0">RHS</a>.</p>
